name: Chondrite
summary: The most common meteorites (~86%), full of chondrules: frozen droplets from the solar nebula 4.56 billion years ago.
sound_desc: Rocks make no sound of their own. Meteors can produce rare 'electrophonic' hissing heard at the same moment they are seen.
